vocabularies.mapModesNote: MAP_MODE_VALUES. Applied as an enum to the single positional argument of map.mode, not to a kwarg.
vocabularies.zoomLevelsNote: ZOOM_LEVEL_TO_MAXZOOM, MapLibre maxZoom semantics. Tuned so regional frames a country pair and city frames a block.
vocabularies.zoomResolutionNote: resolveZoomLevel(level, fallback) returns ZOOM_LEVEL_TO_MAXZOOM[level] ?? fallback, and the adapter passes fallback 4.6. Because 'regional' is also 4.6, an unrecognised zoom_level is indistinguishable from the default: the pin does not reject it. There is no ENUM_KWARGS entry for zoom_level.

map.view.description: Set camera position and zoom level

map.focus.description: Focus camera on a named entity

map.fit.description: Frame multiple registered entities or explicit camera bounds

map.mode.description: Switch rhetorical map mode: political, satellite, street, terrain, or historical overlay

camera.center.description: Center the camera on a target entity with named zoom level. `context_entities` are highlighted/visible but do NOT drag the bounds - fixes mixed-scale fit framing.

camera.focus_region.description: Frame a single region at the requested zoom level.

camera.establish_globe.description: Pull back to a globe-scale establishing shot.

camera.follow_marker.description: Set or clear the chase-camera policy. `track=active_highlights` makes the camera auto-fit to all currently-active highlights and arrows as the scene evolves. `track=none` releases.
camera.follow_marker.note: A policy command. It appears in no compileV2Command branch and in no canonicalizeCommand case: there is nothing to resolve and nothing to compile. Zero occurrences of the action name in runtime.ts.

validationRules.numericRule: Finite-number check only. The pin's lat/lon range checks (-180..180, -90..90) live in validatePieceCoordinates and are applied to piece.place, piece.move and entity.propose - NOT to map.view or camera.establish_globe. Faithful parity therefore bounds no camera coordinate.
validationRules.argEnumRule: Only args[0] is checked, and only when at least one arg is present.
validationRules.entityRefRule: A single required key accepts either the kwarg or a positional argument: 'map.focus requires an entity ref via entity=... or positional arg'.
validationRules.entityListRule: For map.fit, when entities is non-empty it is split on /\s*(?:,|\||;)\s*/ and must yield at least one reference. Note the separators include pipe and semicolon, which the SDK core's comma-only list splitter does not accept - so this rule belongs in a contributed stage, not in a core entityRefList type.
validationRules.mapFitRequirements: map.fit requires entities=... or all four of west/south/east/north. Supplying a partial bound set is rejected: 'map.fit bounds require west, south, east, and north'.
validationRules.noEnumOnZoom: zoom_level, min_zoom and max_zoom carry no ENUM_KWARGS entry; an unrecognised value resolves through the palette fallback rather than being rejected.

resolution.splitEntityList: value.split(/\s*(?:,|\||;)\s*/) then trim and drop empties.
resolution.map.focus: Resolve the ref, then entityCenter(entity) supplies lon/lat. A resolved entity with no centre is reported unresolved. An unresolvable ref makes the command not ok - it is never silently dropped.
resolution.map.fit: Split and resolve every ref. If any is missing, the command fails without computing bounds. Otherwise boundsForEntity per entity, then mergeBounds, then west/south/east/north are written onto the command.
resolution.boundsForEntity: GeoJSON geometry bounds when geometry is present (collectGeometryBounds walks nested coordinate arrays); otherwise a point box of lon/lat +/- POINT_BOUNDS_PADDING_DEGREES (0.25). Null when neither is available.
resolution.entityCenter: entity.coordinates when present, else the centre of its bounds.
resolution.mergeBounds: Antimeridian-aware. Naive min/max merge; if east-west span exceeds 180 degrees, shift bounds whose centre is in the western hemisphere by +360, re-merge, and keep whichever representation yields the smaller arc. A returned west may exceed 180 (for example west=105, east=265); normalisation to MapLibre's [-180,180] is the renderer's job, not the protocol's.

compiler.dispatch: compileV2Command handles camera.center, camera.focus_region and camera.establish_globe. Anything else, including camera.follow_marker, is returned unchanged.

camera.center.note: context_entities is deliberately NOT forwarded into the fit's entity list. That omission is the fix for drag-centring on the largest entity.

camera.focus_region.note: Identical to camera.center's output in the pinned source. The two actions differ in declared vocabulary (context_entities) and author intent, not in the primitive they compile to.

compiler.v2ToolActionsNote: The type predicate isV2ToolAction omits camera.follow_marker, confirming it is a policy rather than a compiled primitive.
